what: [AUD-20260927-CA-A02-pairs-close-ignores-account-dry-run] The pairs sleeve's close and leg-imbalance unwind paths call close_open_position directly, which has no mode/dry_run gate, so an account flipped to mode: dry_run still has pair closes/unwinds sent to the venue. Proposed fix: In _close_pair/_unwind_legs, short-circuit when acct_cfg.get('mode') == 'dry_run' (journal as dry close), mirroring order_monitor. (Tier 2; audit lanes do not enact fixes.)
